original_card.question: Can a specified pair of consecutive calls eliminate a restoration that the next call reconstructs?
methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.
Derive a lower bound for the compulsory transitions of one proposed typed interface.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show actual eliminated work and legal composition; changing a scalar recurrence into a matrix is insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Find a concrete consecutive-call boundary in the selected review and list its entry/exit obligations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Specify two call types and one operation actually removed by composition; derive the normalized recurrence.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Eliminating compulsory boundary work can lower recursive cost beyond packing gains.
allowed_variations: A two-type pilot or one explicit deferred restoration.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting the old scalar recurrence as a matrix without eliminating work.

actual_scope: A two-call typed boundary in the six-row right-regular S3 action: macro A has frame word aba=c and macro B has frame c. Both expose the trivial-character reader sum(W); A and B compose to identity, so their two separate canonical-frame restorations are unnecessary. The full two-direction echo A,B,B,A is priced as well.
scope_change_reason: Refined the card to the shortest reduced relation using all three S3 transpositions and the invariant trivial-character reader. This differs from the active two-generator sign-character claim in discussion 1381 and the order-four cyclic-frame work in PR1391. Each coordinate exchange is explicitly implemented and priced as 3 signed ADD plus 1 NEG, using the operation sequence independently checked in PR1391.
bottleneck_link: This gives an exact local example where a typed exit frame is consumed by the next call, removing paid boundary restoration. No selected supplier or multiplication exponent follows until a real supplier admits this contract.
stop_rule: Exhaust all reduced words of length at most four over the three transpositions; verify both macro orders and the two-direction echo on every workspace vector in {-1,0,1}^6; stop after the invariant and non-invariant reader controls pass. Do not search larger words or infer a supplier admission.
evidence: Exact regular-S3 checker covers 45 reduced words, finds 12 length-four identities, all using all three transpositions, and verifies the shortest witness aba=c followed by c. Each right-transposition has three disjoint row exchanges, each implemented by 3 signed ADD + 1 NEG (9 ADD + 3 NEG total). Including every leaf, macro and parent dispatch, the complete pair vector invoice is 103 eager versus 79 carried; the two-direction echo invoice is 205 versus 157. All 729 bounded dirty vectors preserve the reader output and return the workspace. Coordinate, sign-character, identity-B and wrong-B controls pass.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance: task selection, mathematical formulation, implementation, verification, and writing. No independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.first_step: Pin one candidate supplier's ordered call trace, extract its six-row frame maps and reader, and test the typed A/B endpoint identities before pricing the full family.
